verdict_rationale: The single integrable party for Mercans is the third-party filing provider (owner decision): Mercans hands the provider the data set of section 8 and the provider transmits to each authority, including through the SFTP, web-service and bulk-file channels that some authorities publish. The provider runbook set is not issued until the provider is chosen: Not configured in this release [[GAP:SIR-RQ-41]]
summary: HAS_INTEGRATIONS: the single integrable party for Mercans is the third-party filing provider; 3 authority groups publish a machine channel (SFTP, web service or bulk file) that the provider operates. All other filings are portal, upload or paper through the provider, and the inbound items are documents. The index records the provider hand-off contract.
notes: Provider runbook set deferred until the provider is chosen.
Authority entries with integration=true have no Mercans runbook; operated_by is the filing provider.

outbound_integrations: Statutory filing data hand-off to the third-party filing provider (all in-scope federal, State and local returns, deposits and new-hire reports)
New-hire reporting (State Directory of New Hires; electronic two monthly transmissions)
inbound_integrations: Child-support income withholding orders (IWO / e-IWO) from State agencies
IRS notice of levy on wages (Form 668-W) with the employee's exemption statement
State UI contribution rate notices (annual employer rate per State, e.g. AZ UC-603, CA DE 2088, AK TR02)

authorities.name: Third-party filing provider (owner decision US-MQ-09)
authorities.channel: File hand-off of the provider input data set of section 8; product mapping required
authorities.reason: P1-P7 runbook deferred until the provider is chosen [[GAP:SIR-RQ-41]]

authorities.name: Internal Revenue Service
authorities.channel: Provider-transmitted portal, file upload or electronic return; no system-to-system channel recorded
authorities.source: Report Specifications US-IRS-001 to US-IRS-008; Report Matrix channel statements
authorities.notes: No system-to-system channel recorded for this group.

authorities.name: Social Security Administration
authorities.channel: Provider-transmitted portal, file upload or electronic return; no system-to-system channel recorded
authorities.source: Report Specifications US-SSA-001; Report Matrix channel statements
authorities.notes: No system-to-system channel recorded for this group.

authorities.name: State departments of revenue / taxation (50 States and the District of Columbia)
authorities.channel: DE 8300 e-file guide: Upload Bulk Return File (zip <=10 MB) XML, ICESA or MMREF-1, CSV, or FSET XML web service; Bulk Filing Guide Part A: IT 501, IT 941, SD 101, SD 141, FSET v4.4; ETIN; Pub. 72.5 (2/25) NYS-45 Web Upload: prior approval, test file, agent identification number
authorities.notes: Machine channel published by the authority; no Mercans runbook; the provider operates it.

authorities.name: State workforce / unemployment insurance agencies
authorities.channel: WR-30 quarterly, electronic (online or SFTP), due the 30th with no weekend extension; DOL-4N quarterly; electronic required at 25+ employees; portal entry, CSV/Excel (100-15,000), SFTP (>15,000 and payroll service providers); RPT3795 + NEW0098 quarterly in ESS (entry, SFTP EFW2, CSV/tab)
authorities.notes: Machine channel published by the authority; no Mercans runbook; the provider operates it.

authorities.name: State programme agencies (paid leave, disability, workers' compensation)
authorities.channel: Batch XML (XSD) or CSV via SFTP per File Specification Toolkit v2.1.9; employer-level return totals only; acknowledgement file E/W
authorities.notes: Machine channel published by the authority; no Mercans runbook; the provider operates it.

authorities.name: State Directories of New Hires
authorities.channel: Provider-transmitted portal, file upload or electronic return; no system-to-system channel recorded
authorities.source: Report Specifications US-SDNH-001; Report Matrix channel statements
authorities.notes: No system-to-system channel recorded for this group.

authorities.name: Local taxing authorities (cities, counties, school districts, collectors)
authorities.channel: Provider-transmitted portal, file upload or electronic return; no system-to-system channel recorded
authorities.source: Report Specifications US-LOC-001 to US-LOC-003; Report Matrix channel statements
authorities.notes: No system-to-system channel recorded for this group.

authorities.name: Child-support agencies, IRS levy, State UI rate notices
authorities.channel: Document received by the employer; not parsed by the engine
authorities.source: Report Specifications none (received, not filed); Report Matrix channel statements
authorities.notes: No system-to-system channel recorded for this group.
